epic.title: One spine, one worktree: derive it from the spine path and retire the stamp-and-compare
epic.intent_and_why: A spine's worktree is derived from its path. Nothing stamps it for a decision, nothing compares it, nothing reads an ambient cwd to find it -- so there is no second source of truth that can disagree with the first.

definition_of_done: One pure lexical derivation function, nearest .agent-work ancestor, arbitrary depth, unowned when there is none.
origin_worktree_refusal stops comparing and the per-guarded-verb git rev-parse --show-toplevel is gone.
origin.worktree is still written as provenance and read by nothing for a decision, pinned by a test.
The worktree stops answering 'is this mine' in the Stop hook; binding-key provenance is the discriminator.
#315: command-kind checks run with cwd = the derived worktree.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Subtractive change to engine identity with a silent failure mode; targeted automated tests plus the relevant broader suite
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Local Linux green, independent APPROVE, failure-set difference against a main baseline re-measured at gate time
